## Full Job Description
The Mechanical Quality Manager leads the project quality program for mechanical systems ensuring construction and installation activities conform to engineering designs, industry codes, regulatory requirements, and Tesla standards. You will be responsible for developing and managing quality control documentation to drive system turnover on large-scale mechanical construction projects.
This role owns the inspection, pressure testing, punchlist resolution, and turnover package compilation from installation through commissioning handoff. The Quality Manager works closely with field superintendents, foremen, commissioning teams, and owner’s representatives to ensure systems are completed, documented, and turned over to spec.

...

* Complete and maintain QC checklists for mechanical installations
* Coordinate with field superintendents, foremen, and engineers to identify and resolve quality issues and non-conformance reports (NCRs)
* Interface with Tesla QA/QC personnel and third-party inspection teams during testing and turnover activities
* Maintain organized QC records, test logs, and turnover documentation in project management and document control systems

...

* 5+ years of experience in mechanical construction QC, commissioning support, or systems turnover on industrial or large-scale commercial projects
* Strong working knowledge of pressure testing procedures including hydrostatic and pneumatic testing for piping systems
* Proven experience developing, compiling, and submitting formal turnover packages to owners and engineers
* Advanced knowledge of quality management systems and construction codes/standards applicable to Mechanical Infrastructure (e.g. ASME B31.3, AWS D10.12) together with working knowledge of inspection, testing, and NDE practices used in field assurance programs
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; ability to manage documentation for multiple systems simultaneously
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word); experience with construction management software such as Cx Alloy is a plus
* OSHA 10 or 30 a plus; ability to work in a fast-paced environment across multiple active construction sites
